change.label: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

corrections.reason: The Acts of Union 1800 joined Great Britain and Ireland from 1 January 1801. The state kept this name until 1927, although the Irish Free State left in 1922. The source's shape for these years includes Ireland.

change.label: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

corrections.reason: The Royal and Parliamentary Titles Act 1927 changed the name to reflect the departure of the Irish Free State.
